# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-selkies:ubunturesolute

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG PHOTOCRAFT_RELEASE
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="thelamer"

# title
ENV TITLE="Craft Apps" \
    NO_FULL=true \
    SELKIES_DESKTOP=true \
    PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=true

RUN \
  echo "**** add icon ****" && \
  curl -o \
    /usr/share/selkies/www/icon.png \
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linuxserver/docker-templates/master/linuxserver.io/img/artcraft-logo.png && \
  echo "**** install packages ****" && \
  add-apt-repository ppa:xtradeb/apps && \
  apt-get update && \
  apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    caja \
    chromium \
    chromium-l10n \
    libegl1 \
    xdg-desktop-portal \
    xdg-desktop-portal-gtk && \
  echo "**** install photocraft ****" && \
  if [ -z ${PHOTOCRAFT_RELEASE+x} ]; then \
    PHOTOCRAFT_RELEASE=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/storytold/photocraft/releases/latest" \
      | jq -r '.tag_name'); \
  fi && \
  curl -o \
    /tmp/photocraft.deb -L \
    "https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/releases/download/${PHOTOCRAFT_RELEASE}/photocraft-$(echo ${PHOTOCRAFT_RELEASE} | sed 's/^v//g')-linux-x86_64.deb" && \
  echo "**** install craft suite ****" && \
  for APP in designcraft effectcraft figcraft filmcraft lightcraft pdfcraft vectorcraft; do \
    APP_RELEASE=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/storytold/${APP}/releases/latest" \
      | jq -r '.tag_name') && \
    curl -o \
      /tmp/${APP}.deb -L \
      "https://github.com/storytold/${APP}/releases/download/${APP_RELEASE}/${APP}-$(echo ${APP_RELEASE} | sed 's/^v//g')-linux-x86_64.deb"; \
  done && \
  apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    /tmp/*.deb && \
  echo "**** application tweaks ****" && \
  mv \
    /usr/bin/chromium \
    /usr/bin/chromium-real && \
  sed -i \
    's/^Icon=.*/Icon=system-file-manager-symbolic/' \
    /usr/share/applications/caja.desktop && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  apt-get autoclean && \
  rm -rf \
    /config/.cache \
    /tmp/* \
    /usr/share/applications/caja-autorun-software.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/caja-browser.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/caja-computer.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/caja-file-management-properties.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/caja-folder-handler.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/caja-home.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/debian-uxterm.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/debian-xterm.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/footclient.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/foot-server.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/mate-about.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/mate-color-select.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/mate-network-scheme.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/st.desktop \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/tmp/*

# add local files
COPY /root /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 3001

VOLUME /config

notes.upstream:
## What's Changed
* Updates: shared check-result dialog from craft-update by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10421
* docs: tidy agent, contributor and release docs by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10420
* Keep brush state intact when a preset tip fails to load by @wanikhawar in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10288
* Integration batch: 18 PRs on main by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10145
* Add Finnish interface language by @Janiz-zzz in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/5666
* Preserve imported PSD font metadata during text edits by @jonathanwxh-cell in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/6169
* Move tool: a huge layer isn't copied for every frame of a live drag (#6114, #6163) by @SiFuMax09 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/6985
* Play .atn steps that switch to another open document by @jonathanwxh-cell in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/7621
* Add Pattern Fill option to Layer Panel Footer by @hodd1444 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/7716
* Added advanced selections keyboard shortcuts by @mahefanante in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8015
* i18n: Norwegian Bokmål catalog (nb) by @nikolainyegaard in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8072
* Type: a paragraph box that can't hold its text draws a red + overflow port by @VladimirPozdnyakov in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8311
* Harden Photoshop action export targets and corpus assertions by @bommerts in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8371
* TIFF: images over 2^30 px open, decoded a group of rows at a time into the layer (#8169) by @wanikhawar in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8536
* Edit embedded vectors with original-format save-back through VectorCraft by @mockydevs in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8571
* fix(ui): add transform handles for multi-layer selection by @ekedal in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8623
* feat(ui): Photoshop Fill/Stroke popover and full Color Picker for every colour swatch by @SimoneRecchia in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8725
* Support editing selected color channel sets by @hidoba in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9274
* feat(ui): live canvas preview in the text and gradient stop Color Pickers by @saschaweiss in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9757
* fix(ui): default active tool on startup to Move tool (#5355) by @safvanedge in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/5403
* Print: Scale to Fit Media fills the driver's printable area (#7782) by @jlange91 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/7795
* packaging(flatpak): add OCI image build and GHCR publishing helper by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10567
* Keep a layer's place on its board when dragged to another artboard by @Probler-Yt in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10489
* Layers panel: draw artboard rows like Photoshop, not like folders (#10218) by @Probler-Yt in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10519
* Bound PSD layer and mask import memory before decoding by @wanikhawar in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10503
* Stream PSD user and real masks into tile rows by @wanikhawar in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10532
* Preset panel footers use the Layers footer's glyphs and size (#10656) by @RickiNano in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10672
* Save for Web: keep its size and zoom while the pointer moves (#10675) by @RickiNano in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10685
* Paint the marching ants over the guides (#10671) by @RickiNano in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10681
* Ask before re-importing a brush or gradient file over its group (#10640) by @RickiNano in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10658
* Prefs: startup reads Graphics Adapter through the typed Performance section by @RickiNano in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9618
* Budget PSD pattern expansion and bound multichannel conversion by @wanikhawar in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10541

## New Contributors
* @Janiz-zzz made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/5666
* @mahefanante made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8015
* @mockydevs made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8571
* @ekedal made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8623
* @SimoneRecchia made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8725
* @hidoba made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9274
* @saschaweiss made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9757
* @Probler-Yt made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10489
* @RickiNano made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10672

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/compare/v0.18.0...v0.19.0
